content: Timoseo alombana na Paulo na Sila
Paulo akahikiki ku Delibe na ku Listila, koatamika mbulwa jumu joalowakika Timoseo. Amabhu waki najombi akabhi mbulwa, akabhi Myahude, nambu atati waki akabhi Mgiliki.
Bhahobhalela bhokapi bha ku Listila na ku Ikonio bhakalongi ulandilu wambone panani jaka Timoseo.

Paulo akapaliki antola Timoseo mu mwanja waki, bhela akunhekiti jando. Akatehi bhenibhela kwa ndandi ja Bhayahude bhabhakabhi bhatama pandu panipala, maghambu bhokapi bhakamanyi kubha atati waka Timoseo akabhi Mgiliki.
Mu michi jokapi jebhapetiki, bhakalongili kwa bhabhulwa malaghalakilu ghaghabhohakiki na mitumi na bhazee bha ku Yelusalemu, na kubhapwaghi bhaghakamula malaghalaki ghokape.
Bhela makanisa ghakajonjukiki makili mu uhobhalelu na ubhalangiku wa bhabhulwa ukajonjukiki mu kila lichobha.
Paulo abhona mabono ku muchi wa ku Tiloa
Paulo papamu na bhajaki bhakapetiki ku inchi ja ku Filigia na ku Galatia, maghambu Roho Mhuhu ngachebhapwaghi kutangaza Lilobhi laka Chapanga ku inchi ja ku Asia.
Pabhahiki mu malindakanilu gha Misia, bhakalengiki kujenda ku inchi ja Bisinia, nambu Roho waka Yesu ngacheabhajetakile.
Bhela bhakapetiki ku mkoa wa ku Misia na kujenda ku Tiloa.
Pakwahiki ikilu Paulo akaweni mabhono gha kubha akumbweni mundu jumu wa ku Makedonia ajemi na anjopa, “Ulombukaje, uhika ku Makedonia utujangatyaje!”
Palapala Paulo paakaweni mabhono ghanihagha, tukalibhehi wichu kujenda ku Makedonia, maghambu tukamanyi kubha Chapanga akatulohiki kujenda kutangaza Malobhi Manyahi kwa bhandu bha konikola.
Lidia anhobhalela Bambo
Kuhuma ku Tiloa tukalombwiki kwa sitima mbaka ku Samosilake, na lichobha lelijengalyaje tukalombwiki ku Neapoli.
Kuhuma konihoku tukapiti ku Filipi, muchi ukolongwa wa ku Makedonia, ghoukabhi pahi ja utawala wa Bhaloma. Tukatami konihoku kwa machobha machokope.

Lichobha la Sabato tukapitiki kunja ja muchi na kujenda pambipi na nkoka, patwaholali kubha pandu patuweza kuhimangana kwa kundobha Chapanga. Tukatami, na kulongela na akambomba bhabhalibhongini pandu panipala.

Jumu wa akambomba bhabhabhi bhatujowanela akabhi Lidia kuhuma ku Tiatila, joakabhi ndombesa wa ingobhu ya langi ja zambalau ya mbija yamaheli. Akabhi mbomba joanjojabhe Chapanga, na Bambo akaubhopwi mtima waki kughajopalela malobhi ghokapi ghalongila Paulo.
Paabatizwi jombi na bhandu bha munyumba jaki, akatupembalili akapwaghaje, “Ngati anambona kubha chakaka nunhobhali Bambo, tambokanya mwakatama kunyumba jangu.” Tukajetakili kujenda kunyumba jaki.
Paulo na Sila bhajeghaleka muligeleza

Lichobha limu patupita pandu pa kundobha Chapanga, tukahimangini na mtumika jumu wa chimbomba joakabhi na majobhi na uwezu wa kulondola. Kwa indela jaki ja kulondola akabhapeki akabambo bhaki mbija yamahele.
Mtumika hoju akunjengali Paulo na tepani, akajamalyaje, “Bhandu habha nde bhatumika bhaka Chapanga Nkolongwa wa Kunani Nakanope! Bhuntangazi indela ja kuweza kukengaleka!”

Akahengiki bhenibhela kwa machobha ghamahele, mbaka lichobha limu Paulo akahakalili namaa na kumpwaghi lijobhi jola, “Nukukenjukila kwa lihina laka Yesu Kristo umpita mwali hoju!” Palapala lijobhi akumpitiki mwali jola.
Akabambo bhaka mwali jola bhakaweni kubha uhobhalelu wabhu wa kupata mbija ujomwike, bhakabhakamwi Paulo na Sila na kubhahutana mbaka paligulio palongi ja ihongozi.
Bhakabhapeliki kwa ihongozi bha ku Loma na kupwagha, “Bhandu abhabha nde Bhayahude, na bhaleta fujo pa muchi witu.
Bhabhola mitetu jejipengana na malaghalakilu ghitu, tepani twa Bhaloma, na ngachetupalika kujijetakela na kujijengalela.”
Lipogha la bhandu lakalibhongini na kubhalapu Paulo na Sila. Bhela bhatemula bhala bhakabhahuliki ingobhu yaka Paulo na Sila kwa makili, na kulaghalaki bhalapulika iboko.
Pabhajomwi kubhalapula nakanopi, bhakabhabhehi muligeleza, na bhakundaghalakili nkolongwa wa bhalonda bha ligeleza kubhabheka pahi ja ulingalilu ukale.
Kubhokana na amuli jeniheji, mlonda akabhabhehi muchumba cha mkati nakanopi na kughakonga magholu ghabhu pa ligogo.
Pamahiku Paulo na Sila bhakabhi bhalobha na kundumbali Chapanga, na bhakongeka bhangi bhakabhi bhajowanela.
Palapala kukapitali kinyukunyuku cha ndema, chikanyuhiki misingi ja ligeleza panihapa milyangu ja ligeleza jakahowiki na pengu ikabhopwiki.
Mlonda wa ligeleza paakajumwiki na kubhona milyangu ja ligeleza jihoghuliki, akaholali kubha bhakongeka bhokapi bhatilike, na panihapa akaliholapwi lipanga laki na kupala kulikoma.
Nambu Paulo akajamalili akapwaghaje, “Ngawalipoteka wamwete! Tepani tabhokapi tubhi pambane!”
Mlonda jola akajopiki bhundetila taa, akakembali mkati, na kulileke pamagholu ghaka Paulo na Sila.
Bhela akabhalongwi kunja na kubhalalukila, “Bhakolongwa bhango, bho, nhenga kiki nahuli mbata kukengaleka?”
Bhombi bhakamuyangike, “Unhobhalya Bambo Yesu, wikengalika wehapa papamu na bhandu bha munyumba jaku.”
Bhela bhakuntangazi Lilobhi laka Bambo jombi papamu na bhandu bhabhakabhi munyumba jake.
Chikahi chelachela cha ikilu mlonda wa ligeleza akabhatoliki na kubhagholola hilonda yabhu, na panihapa jombi na bhalongu bhaki bhakabatizwi palapala.
Bhela akabhatoliki Paulo na Sila mbaka kunyumba jaki na kubhapeke chilebhe. Jombi na bhalongu bhaki bhakatweliwi na chiheku, maghambu bhakunhobhali Chapanga.
Chilabhu jaki lukela bhatemula bha ku Loma bhakabhatumiki manjolinjoli kwaka mlonda wa muligeleza na kumpwaghila, “Wabhopula bhandu bhala.”
Bhela mlonda wa ligeleza jola akumpwaghi Paulo, “Bhakolongwa bhalaghalaki nukubhopulya wehapa na Sila. Sajenu muweza kubhoka na kujenda kwa lukwale.”

Nambu Paulo akabhapwaghi manjolinjoli bhala, “Bhatulapwi iboko palongi ja bhandu bhokapi panga na uhakau wokapi ghola koni tepani nde bhandu bha ku Loma. Na kutukonga muligeleza. Bho, sajenu bhapala kutulekakela kwa kulihiya? Ngaiwezikane! Bhatemula bha ku Loma bhapalika bhahika bheni bhatubhopulyaje.”
Manjolinjoli bhakakelawiki na kubhapwaghi bhatemula bha ku Loma malobhi ghala, na pabhakajowini kubha Paulo na Sila nde bhandu bha ku Loma, bhakajowipi namaa.
Bhela bhakapiti na kubhapembalela, bhakabhapihiki kunja ja ligeleza, na kubhapwaghi bhabhokaje pa muchi ghonighola.
Paulo na Sila pabhakapitiki muligeleza bhakapiti kunyumba jaka Lidia. Konihoku bhakahimangini na bhahobhalela, bhakabhapeki malobhi gha kubhajeghe mtima, na bhakabhokike.
